title: Skali installer existing-cluster configuration
description: Configuration consumed by skali cluster install --mode existing-cluster --config.

email.description: Email of the first admin account.

passwordFile.description: Path to a file holding the admin password.

capabilities.description: Capabilities the installation advertises; defaults to application, database, registry, edge.

storage.description: Bootstrap database volume size, for example 10Gi.

tier.description: Database availability tier: single, asynchronous, or synchronous. Defaults to single.

api.description: Public api/ui domain, for example skali.example.com.

registry.description: Public managed-registry domain, for example registry.example.com.

className.description: IngressClass name for the api/ui and registry edges, for example nginx.

certManager.description: cert-manager: install or use-existing. Defaults to install.

cnpg.description: CNPG operator: install or use-existing. Defaults to install.

storage.description: Managed registry volume size, for example 20Gi.

imageId.description: Optional image content identity behind a mutable tag.

className.description: StorageClass for the database and registry volumes; empty uses the cluster default.

acmeServer.description: Optional ACME directory URL override; empty selects the Let's Encrypt production endpoint. Point test installations at the staging endpoint.

issuerEmail.description: ACME account email for certificate issuance.
